subject: AWS co-sell: mutual action plan & demo sync
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@novamed.com>, Michael Lo <michael.lo@amazon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS co-sell: mutual action plan & demo sync

Hi Priya / Michael —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, NovaMed looks like a strong fit for a pilot using Redwood Inference (low-latency inference for clinical summarization). To keep momentum with AWS this quarter, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) and a proposed demo agenda.

Quick asks from our side to get the AWS co-sell moving:
- Michael / AWS: can you confirm whether you want to own the formal co-sell introduction to NovaMed procurement?
- Priya: is Nov 3 or Nov 5 preferable for a joint demo (30–45 min)? Nov 3 10:00am PT would be ideal for our engineers.
- Can you both confirm the procurement contact at NovaMed so we can include them in the MAP?

Attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx (mutual action plan draft), deck-demo-agenda.pdf (demo flow + success criteria).

Proposed high-level milestones (from MAP):
1) Nov 3: joint demo + technical Q&A
2) Nov 10: eval instance access and short POC (2 weeks)
3) Nov 30: procurement/contract runway discussion

If those dates look OK I’ll lock in a calendar invite and add a short prep sync for our internal team.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

---
Attachment stubs: MAP-draft.xlsx (14kb), deck-demo-agenda.pdf (560kb)

From: Michael Lo <michael.lo@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: mutual action plan & demo sync

Karthik / Priya —

Thanks for looping me in. Happy to support the co-sell intro. Nov 3 at 10:00am PT works for my calendar; I can bring a solutions architect (Sara Wu) who can speak to procurement requirements and marketplace listing expectations.

I attached the standard AWS co-sell checklist that NovaMed can use to prepare (procurement docs, security questionnaire contacts, PO flow). On procurement ownership: AWS can coordinate outreach to procurement but we typically ask the customer to share their procurement contact directly so we can include them in the MAP and procurement timeline.

I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Best,
Michael
Partner Development Manager, AWS
michael.lo@amazon.com

---
Attachment stub: aws-cosell-checklist.pdf (120kb)

Hi Karthik / Michael —

Nov 3 at 10:00am PT works for us — please send the invite. We’re definitely interested in the POC path you outlined. Procurement contact is Alejandro Torres (alejandro.torres@novamed.com), and I’ve copied him on this thread. He can speak to timeline and preferred contracting flow.

One request from our side: can the demo include a short section on data handling and logging (SOC2, retention, and ability to run in our VPC)? That will help speed internal approval.

Looking forward —
Priya
VP Product, NovaMed Health

Subject: FW: AWS co-sell: mutual action plan & demo sync

Laura / Vivek —

Looping you both in since we have the Nov 3 10:00am PT slot confirmed with NovaMed + AWS. Action items before the demo:
- Laura: can your team prepare a 10–12 minute demo focusing on low-latency inference, data handling options (hosted vs private), and SOC2 controls? Please include one slide that maps Redwood deployment options to NovaMed security needs.
- Vivek: please prep an internal one-pager on pricing/discount guidance for a 2-week POC and a follow-on quarterly commit (numbers we can share with procurement).
- Karthik: I’ll finalize the MAP and send the calendar invite with the deck. I’ll also add Alejandro Torres (procurement) to the invite.

Meeting will be: Nov 3, 10:00am–10:45am PT — joint demo + procurement Q&A.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
